evidence.quote: He plucked three pieces from the tree's branches and went back to the kitchen.
He handed Bajie and Wujing each a ginseng fruit.
"This fruit is delicious!"
"Yes," said Wukong. "It truly is."
The two priests yelled and yelled.
They called Wukong and his companions all sorts of terrible names.
There was a loud crack, and the entire tree crashed to the ground.

answers.rationale: 原文明确写整棵人参果树轰然倒地，所以 A 成立；悟空摘了三颗、只把两颗交给八戒和悟净，并回应果子确实美味，故“悟空没吃”不成立；两名道士不断辱骂他们，也绝非礼貌。

evidence.quote: "You two wait here," said Wukong.
"I'll go pick some of that fruit."
The monkey went behind the abbey and found the giant ginseng tree.
He plucked three pieces from the tree's branches and went back to the kitchen.

answers.rationale: 悟空让八戒和悟净等候，自己去树后摘下三颗果子，所以是悟空采摘；八戒和悟净都留在厨房窗口旁，没有去摘。

evidence.quote: "You're all thieves and liars!" cried one of the priests.
The two priests yelled and yelled.
They called Wukong and his companions all sorts of terrible names.
"Those priests are rude!" he said to himself.
"So what if we ate some ginseng fruit? They have no right to call us names!"
Wukong grew very angry.

answers.rationale: 道士称他们为贼和骗子并不断恶语辱骂，悟空因此愤怒；果子味道很好，唐僧是否吃果子也不是他发怒的原因。

evidence.quote: "I don't want to listen to this," thought the monkey.
He recited a quick spell and changed into a spirit form.
He left his body standing in the room and went out behind the abbey.

answers.rationale: 悟空念了一个简短咒语，变成灵体离开仍站在房中的肉身；他没有睡着，也没有把身体劈成两半。

evidence.quote: "But the monkey was inside the whole time," said the other priest.
"He's a spirit," said the first priest.
"He must have used magic."
Inside the abbey the Tang Monk was scolding his companions.
"I am very upset you stole fruit from our hosts."
He suddenly stood much taller.
"I am the Great Immortal! You destroyed my ginseng tree. You're not going any farther until you give me a new one!"

answers.rationale: 道士明确说悟空一直在屋内，只能推断他用法术毁树，没人亲眼看见；唐僧确实为偷果子生气，大仙也明确要求他们赔一棵新树，因此 A 是不正确项。

evidence.quote: "You're all welcome to spend the night," said one of the priests. "Follow us."
The priests led the group to a small room in the abbey.
The Tang Monk and his companions went inside.
Wukong noticed that the priests didn't come in.
He was about to say something when one priest slammed the door shut.
A lock clicked.
"Wait!" cried Bajie. "What kind of hosts are you? You locked us in!"

answers.rationale: 道士把四人带进小房间，留在门外关门上锁；他们没有获准离开，道士也没有带他们去看树。

evidence.quote: "Master, don't worry," said Wukong.
"I'll get us out of here. When the priests go to sleep, I'll use my lock-picking magic. Then we'll be on our way."
The four travelers escaped that night and headed west.

answers.rationale: 悟空明确计划等道士睡着后用开锁法术，原文随后说众人当夜逃走；八戒此前踢门只伤了脚，故事也没有从窗户逃离。

evidence.quote: The next day they saw an old man on the road.
"Excuse me," said the man.
He suddenly stood much taller.
"I am the Great Immortal! You destroyed my ginseng tree. You're not going any farther until you give me a new one!"

answers.rationale: 路上的老人突然变高并自称大仙，所以遇到的是大仙；他不是菩萨，也不是此前两个守观道士中的一人。

evidence.quote: Back at the abbey, the Great Immortal told his priests to start a fire.
"Bring out a large frying pan," said the Great Immortal.
"We're going to fry these criminals. Let's start with Sun Wukong."
"I can sit on that frying pan all day and not get hurt at all. But the Tang Monk is mortal. He'll be burned to a crisp!"
"He escaped without us!"
"He's gone! He probably returned to the Fruit and Flower Mountain. I'm sure he's playing in a field of flowers right now. Meanwhile we're trapped here!"
"Bring out another frying pan. We'll fry his companions, starting with the Tang Monk!"

answers.rationale: 大仙命人起火架锅煎“这些罪犯”，后来又明确要从唐僧开始煎其他同伴，所以 A 成立；悟空一直在现场用替身脱身，并未回花果山；唐僧是凡人，悟空还明确担心他会被烧焦。

evidence.quote: Back at the abbey, the Great Immortal told his priests to start a fire.
"Bring out a large frying pan," said the Great Immortal.
The priests carried an enormous frying pan into the room.
They placed it over the fire.

answers.rationale: 大仙命令拿出大煎锅，道士把巨大的煎锅架在火上；原文不是普通锅或水壶。

evidence.quote: A short while later, Wukong and Guanyin arrived at the abbey.
Guanyin told Wukong, Bajie, and Wujing to stand the tree back up.
Guanyin rose into the air and poured the dew over the ginseng tree.
The tree's color came back, and new leaves and fruit grew.
"Sorry I didn't believe you earlier."
Up ahead, an evil spirit named Lady Whitebone sat by the side of the road.
She had been waiting by the road for years.

answers.rationale: 观音亲自来到道观、洒甘露使人参果树复活，因此“没有帮助”被直接反驳；八戒随后向悟空道歉，白骨夫人也确实等待唐僧多年，所以 A 是不正确项。

evidence.quote: The Great Immortal thought for a moment.
"Okay, Wukong. I will give you until the end of the day to fix my ginseng tree. If you can't, the Tang Monk goes into the frying pan."
"Bodhisattva!" cried the monkey. "I need your help! A Daoist named the Great Immortal is going to fry the Tang Monk. I have until the end of the day to fix his ginseng tree."

answers.rationale: 大仙两次明确限定悟空必须在当天结束前修好树；不是一周末或一月末。

evidence.quote: Soon the tree looked just as it had the day before.
To thank everyone, the Great Immortal decided to host a feast.
"I would like to share some ginseng fruit with everyone here," he said.
The two priests brought in trays of ginseng fruits.

answers.rationale: 树复活后大仙设宴并明确要把人参果分享给在场众人；他没有提出教悟空控制愤怒，也没有要吃唐僧或八戒。

evidence.quote: "Don't believe Wukong," said Bajie.
"He used magic to turn the food into worms."
The Tang Monk frowned.
"I want you to leave, Wukong," said the Tang Monk.
"Master," said the monkey. "I just saved your life."
"I don't believe you," said the monk.

answers.rationale: 八戒说悟空把食物变成虫，唐僧最终也明确说不相信悟空，所以 A 成立；紧箍咒由唐僧念，不是白骨夫人；唐僧没有救悟空，反而赶他走。

evidence.quote: Soon after the monkey had left, a young woman came down the road.
Just then an old woman came down the road.
Just then an old man came down the road.

answers.rationale: 白骨夫人的三个伪装依次是年轻女子、老妇和老翁，没有年轻男子；老妇和年轻女子都在选项中且确实出现，因此 A 是未使用的伪装。

evidence.quote: "Don't believe Wukong," said Bajie.
"He used magic to turn the food into worms."
The pig looked at the ground where the woman had been and shook his head.
"Wukong hit her so hard, there isn't anything left of her."
"He killed another innocent person!" cried the pig.

answers.rationale: 八戒和唐僧把悟空的攻击理解为杀害无辜的人，八戒甚至说他杀了又一个无辜者；他们没有认为悟空在帮助妖怪或保护大家。

evidence.quote: "That's ridiculous," said Wukong. "I—ahh!"
The monkey rolled on the ground as the Tang Monk recited the Tight Headband spell.
The Tang Monk recited the spell again.
Wukong fell to the ground in pain.

answers.rationale: 唐僧两次念紧箍咒使悟空倒地疼痛；没有给他食物，也没有用金箍棒攻击他。

evidence.quote: The Tang Monk frowned.
"I want you to leave, Wukong," said the Tang Monk.
"I don't believe you," said the monk.
"Now leave or I'll recite the spell again."

answers.rationale: 唐僧最终明确命悟空离开，并以再次念咒相威胁；不是让他继续保护，也不是让他找虫子。

evidence.quote: The pig lay down behind some bushes.
Soon he was snoring loudly.
He peered behind some bushes and saw the pig fast asleep.
"May I have more tofu?" asked Bajie.
He was talking in his sleep.
"Yes, please cook lots more. I will eat it all."
But when they got there, the Tang Monk was gone.
The monster laughed.
"I have a monk here. I'm going to eat him for dinner!"

answers.rationale: 吃豆腐和面条的是睡梦中说话的八戒，并非悟净；八戒确实睡在灌木后，唐僧也确实被塔中妖怪扣下准备吃掉，所以 A 是不正确项。

evidence.quote: "Bajie," said the Tang Monk.
"Why don't you go find us some food? Wujing and I will wait here."
The pig moaned. "Ugh! I just sat down!"
Then he wandered off.

answers.rationale: 唐僧明确派八戒去找食物；当时悟净尚未遇险，唐僧也没有叫他去睡觉。

evidence.quote: Meanwhile the Tang Monk became bored.
The monk walked quietly through the woods, admiring flowers and plants as he went.
He went deeper and deeper into the forest.
Then, in the midst of all the trees, he saw a pagoda.
"This is a strange place for a pagoda," he thought.

answers.rationale: 唐僧在森林深处看见一座塔；他不是发现道路，也没有在那里发现另一名和尚。

evidence.quote: The Tang Monk was tied up in a room.
"I'm a prisoner here," said the woman.
"That monster kidnapped me 13 years ago and won't let me leave. Will you help me?"
The king stood up, his eyes blazing with anger.
He called to his general, who was standing nearby.
"Gather your troops," said the king.
"I want my daughter back. And I want that monster destroyed!"

answers.rationale: 唐僧是被绑在妖怪处后才遇到公主，并非前来营救她；公主明确被囚十三年，国王也明确命将军召集军队消灭妖怪，所以 A 是不正确项。

evidence.quote: "I can help you get free," said the young woman.
"If I do, will you deliver a letter to my parents?"
"Of course," said the monk. "Who are your parents?"
"They're the king and queen of the Precious Image Kingdom," said the young woman.
"My name is Princess Hundred Flowers."

answers.rationale: 公主答应帮唐僧脱身后，唐僧承诺替她把信交给父母；他没有承诺亲自救公主或亲自与妖怪战斗。

evidence.quote: Bajie and Wujing were still fighting the monster when the princess ran outside.
"Monster!" she cried. "I must ask you a favor."
"There's a monk inside," said the princess.
"It makes me so sad to see him tied up. Won't you let him go?"
"That monk isn't an ordinary monk. He's the—" Princess Hundred Flowers pretended to cry.
"Okay, okay, sweetie. You know I only want you to be happy. The monk may go."

answers.rationale: 公主假装伤心，请妖怪释放被绑的唐僧，妖怪随后同意；她没有让妖怪送信，也没有让他抓悟净。

evidence.quote: Bajie and Wujing attacked.
Finally Bajie, tired from fighting, turned and ran.
Wujing was furious.
"Bajie!" he shouted. "Where are you—oof!"
The monster knocked out Wujing and tied him up.
He dragged Wujing into the pagoda and locked him in a room.

answers.rationale: 八戒逃跑后，妖怪打昏、捆住并关押悟净；八戒成功逃回，悟空此时并不在场。

evidence.quote: "Princess Hundred Flowers tricked me!" said the monster.
Then he sighed. "I can't be angry with her. I love her too much. But that pig got away. He'll go back to the king, and troops will come."
Bajie ran back to the Precious Image Kingdom.
He told the king that he and Wujing couldn't save Princess Hundred Flowers.
"As I ran away, Wujing was captured."
Everybody gasped. Now a tiger sat in the Tang Monk's spot!
"He's locked up in a cage," said the other boy.

answers.rationale: 公主仍在妖怪处，回宫向国王报告失败和悟净被抓的是八戒，并非公主本人；八戒确实跑回宝象国，变成老虎的唐僧也确实被锁进笼子，所以 A 是不正确项。

evidence.quote: "I need a disguise," he said to himself.
He recited a quick spell.
Light sparkled. Now the monster looked like a handsome young man.

answers.rationale: 妖怪念咒后伪装成英俊年轻男子；他没有伪装成老虎或马。

evidence.quote: A handsome young man walked into the hall.
"I married Princess Hundred Flowers 13 years ago," said the young man.
"I found her in a forest just as a tiger was about to attack her. I saved her life and chased away the tiger."

answers.rationale: 伪装的年轻男子告诉国王自己在森林中从老虎口中救下公主并赶走老虎；他没有说赶走唐僧，也没有说从妖怪手中救悟净。

evidence.quote: The young man narrowed his eyes at the Tang Monk and pointed. "That monk!"
"I'll prove it," said the young man.
He pointed at the monk again and recited a spell. Light sparkled.
Everybody gasped. Now a tiger sat in the Tang Monk's spot!

answers.rationale: 年轻男子施法后，唐僧的位置出现一只老虎，说明唐僧被变成老虎；不是泛称怪物，也不是年轻男子。

evidence.quote: He saw the horse peeking from behind a wall.
"Shh," said the horse. "We have a problem. A young man turned the Tang Monk into a tiger. The monk is locked in a cage now."
"The young man is probably just the monster in disguise. We need to defeat him and save our companions."
The horse thought for a minute.
"You must find Wukong. He can help us."

answers.rationale: 龙马判断年轻人是妖怪伪装，明确要求八戒去找悟空；悟净已经被抓，龙马也没有让他去找观音。

evidence.quote: Light sparkled, and the servant turned into Bajie.
The monster sighed. "I got a note. It said there was a monkey here, and he was trying to destroy my pagoda."
"He didn't destroy the pagoda. What did he want?"
"But he freed the purple spirit you had captured."
Suddenly Wukong stood before the monster.
"I freed the princess too!"

answers.rationale: 妖怪亲口确认塔没有被毁，直接反驳 A；八戒确实变成仆人，悟空也从公主伪装中现身并说自己释放了公主，因此 A 是不正确项。

evidence.quote: Bajie hesitated for a moment and then leaped onto a cloud.
He soared through the sky and soon arrived at the Fruit and Flower Mountain.
He found Wukong sitting beside the big waterfall.

answers.rationale: 八戒飞到花果山，在大瀑布旁找到悟空；不是在妖怪的塔或宝象国找到他。

evidence.quote: "Oh, I did tell him about you," Bajie lied.
"Really?" Wukong leaned closer.
"What did he say?"
Bajie bit his lip.
"He laughed and said that you're a tiny little coward."

answers.rationale: 八戒为激怒悟空，谎称妖怪笑他是小小的胆小鬼；没有说妖怪害怕悟空，也没有说妖怪身处危险。

evidence.quote: Then he saw Princess Hundred Flowers and relaxed.
"Why did you think that?" asked the princess.
The princess hesitated.
"You're not going to be happy about this," she said.
There was a flash of light.
Suddenly Wukong stood before the monster.
"I freed the princess too!"

answers.rationale: 与妖怪交谈的“公主”最后闪光变回悟空，说明悟空伪装成公主；仆人是八戒的伪装，悟空也没有伪装成八戒。
